original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP_NVME_B1 through BN sensors are correctly mapped to their physical bays and installed drives and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved NVMe thermal specification.
original_method: Enumerate the complete B-group bay/drive population and immutable BMC raw/UI sensor identities, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized drive identity, health, power state and optionally approved same-drive telemetry, and compare results under the owner correlation and timing rules.
manual_activity: The owner provides B-group bay/drive/sensor mapping, thermal limits and any device-telemetry correlation rule; an operator verifies raw/UI/drive identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and NVMe B1..BN bay/drive inventory
Physical B-group bay to drive serial/namespace and SDR/Redfish/UI sensor mapping
Temperature unit/scale/warning/critical threshold and expected range specification
Approved relationship and timing between BMC sensor and read-only same-drive NVMe telemetry
UI refresh/rounding/lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never write storage, start an unapproved workload or change drive power/thermal/cooling policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to physical bay and immutable drive identity at synchronized times
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on NVMe health/thermal alarm, I/O impact, stale/impossible value, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not assume BMC and device temperatures must match or retry after creating load
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify all B-group NVMe bay, drive and sensor mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only drive context
Assist with synchronized WebUI and approved same-drive telemetry capture/normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/device/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no storage workload/write or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative B-group topology, thermal limits and BMC/device correlation rules
Review bay/drive identity, sensor-location, timing and raw/UI/device discrepancies

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED NVME B-GROUP TEMPERATURE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-bay matrix of B-group slot, drive identity/power/health, BMC sensor identity/value/threshold and UI display, plus approved same-drive telemetry with timestamps and location/lag interpretation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable bay-to-drive mapping and source-aware thermal correlation while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and workload generation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One sensor value or screenshot cannot cover B1..BN or prove the installed drive. Every expected bay/sensor and occupied/empty state must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC may sense a backplane location while NVMe telemetry is on-device; different placement and polling windows can legitimately yield different temperatures.

project_override_considerations: If empty B-group bays omit sensors or retain backplane temperatures, the owner must define expected empty-state behavior; N-group rows and telemetry cannot fill missing B-group coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/NVMe B-group topology/thermal spec revision
Per-B-group bay to drive serial/namespace and raw/UI sensor identity matrix
Complete BMC temperature/unit/status/threshold/entity/timestamp plus drive health/power-state context
Synchronized WebUI and approved same-drive telemetry with source/location/lag comparison
Per-bay discrepancies, no-workload/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target B-group NVMe temperatures and thresholds. Exact bay mapping and BMC-versus-device correlation are project inputs rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: B-group topology, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/drive-context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Makes bay-to-drive identity and sensor-source differences explicit so readable BMC values cannot be mistaken for complete or same-drive coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A bay label is not sufficient identity because drives can be moved and the BMC sensor may be on a backplane rather than inside the device. Correct correlation must freeze bay, serial/namespace and sensor identifiers at the same time. BMC and device temperatures can differ due to physical location and polling lag, so an owner rule is required instead of equality. Empty bays also need explicit semantics because a backplane temperature may remain valid without a drive.
